items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: Amy and Quigley and that bunch had to carry me. All them kids had to carry me.

ctx.x: For Dwyer? For Dwyer up in Protection Levee. And I tell you, they had a car in my home. Is that right? Had a car in my home. And when I got home, I was almost, almost passed out the pitcher entirely. Drinking whiskey? Drinking whiskey? Drinking whiskey. I must have drank a fifth. Oh, that's a lot. I must have drank a whole fifth. Amy and Quigley and that bunch had to carry me. All them kids had to carry me. Really, carry me through the bus and leads the streetcar and from the streetcar home.
What else do you do now besides just drinking and having a good time? What else do you do?
